description:
You are the Race Director and Event Operations Manager for the 'Fells 25K Trail Race'. You must build the official GPS data package in Garmin BaseCamp to be uploaded to aid station timing computers and shared with race medical staff.

The BaseCamp library already contains the fells_loop terrain reference data (use it for geographic reference only — do NOT modify existing waypoints).

Create the following 8 new waypoints in My Collection with the exact names, coordinates, symbols, and comments shown:

1. Name: START - BELLEVUE POND  |  Lat: 42.4325  Lon: -71.1295  |  Symbol: Flag, Blue  |  Comment: Official Start/Finish. Timing chip mat at 0.0km and 25.0km. Bag check closes 07:45.
2. Name: AS1 - NORTH LOOP  |  Lat: 42.4495  Lon: -71.1240  |  Symbol: Food/Water  |  Comment: Aid Station 1. Km 7.2. Water, electrolytes, fruit. NO crew access.
3. Name: AS2 - SHEEPFOLD NORTH  |  Lat: 42.4530  Lon: -71.1020  |  Symbol: Food/Water  |  Comment: Aid Station 2. Km 12.8. Drop bags allowed. Crew OK via Sheepfold Rd.
4. Name: AS3 - SOUTH FELLS  |  Lat: 42.4240  Lon: -71.1050  |  Symbol: Food/Water  |  Comment: Aid Station 3. Km 19.3. Water, gels, broth. NO crew access.
5. Name: MANDATORY CP  |  Lat: 42.4460  Lon: -71.1055  |  Symbol: Danger  |  Comment: MANDATORY CHECKPOINT. Km 15.4. Cutoff: 4h30m from start. MUST CHECK IN.
6. Name: CREW ACCESS A  |  Lat: 42.4355  Lon: -71.1250  |  Symbol: Car  |  Comment: Crew Access Point A. Parking on West St. Runners enter from S only.
7. Name: CREW ACCESS B  |  Lat: 42.4218  Lon: -71.1140  |  Symbol: Car  |  Comment: Crew Access Point B. Parking off Ravine Rd. No road crossings during race.
8. Name: MEDICAL CP  |  Lat: 42.4270  Lon: -71.1080  |  Symbol: Medical Facility  |  Comment: Race Medical. Km 21.0. ALS crew on site 07:00-17:00 race day. AED on site.

Create this 1 route (add all 9 waypoints in the exact order listed):

Route — Name: FELLS 25K OFFICIAL COURSE  |  Waypoints in order: START - BELLEVUE POND, AS1 - NORTH LOOP, AS2 - SHEEPFOLD NORTH, MANDATORY CP, AS3 - SOUTH FELLS, CREW ACCESS B, MEDICAL CP, CREW ACCESS A, START - BELLEVUE POND

Export the collection as GPX: File → Export → Export 'My Collection'... → GPX → save to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ with filename Fells25K_Official_Course_2024.gpx
